rationale: S-0022-02 proposes a Nav1.6 distal-AIS density sweep on the t0022 testbed to close the 15 Hz -> 30-40 Hz peak-rate gap. The from-scratch wave (t0052 / t0053 / t0054) supersedes the t0022 substrate as the primary platform; the peak-rate gap is now being addressed via t0054's NMDA scaling and the upcoming t0057 tonic-GABA work. The Nav1.6 channel question itself remains scientifically valid but is no longer on the from-scratch-wave critical path. Reprioritising from high to medium.
